scope.flow: swap and multihop swap execution in Router.sol without a deadline parameter
scope.environment: AMM router contract (Router.sol) with swap, multihopSwap, multiMultihopSwap functions
evidence: Missing deadline check in swap allows stale transactions to execute at unfavourable prices

The ```swap``` and the ```multihop``` functions lack a deadline parameter, allowing transactions to execute at unfavourable prices after sitting in the mempool due to network congestion or low gas fees.
AMMs should provide their users with an option to limit the time of the execution of their pending actions, such as swaps or adding and removing liquidity.
The most common solution is to include a deadline timestamp as a parameter as it has been done correctly in this ```swapExactTokensForTokens``` function.
Without a deadline parameter, users transactions can be executed at unexpected times when market conditions are unfavourable.
- ```swap()``` (all overloads)
- ```multihopSwap()```
- ```multiMultihopSwap()```
1) Alice submits swap at 10:00 AM: 3000 USDC → 1 WETH (minimum 2990 USDC worth)
2) Transaction has low gas priority, sits in mempool during network congestion
3) At 3:00 PM, market crashes (-20%), her transaction finally executes

ambiguities: Report does not state whether the swap functions are callable by anyone or any authorization condition; no unauthorized-caller precondition asserted.
The deadline value (10:30 AM) appears only in a hypothetical 'with deadline protection' scenario, not as an actual submitted parameter.
Report does not specify the exact slippage percentage bound; 'up to slippage % value loss' is left unquantified.
Whether the transaction was actually observed executing at 3:00 PM is presented as an example scenario, not a confirmed on-chain event.
